title: Hotel Check-In

lines.en: Good evening, sir. Welcome to the Riverside Hotel.
lines.zh: 先生晚安。歡迎光臨 Riverside 飯店。

lines.en: Hi. I'd like to check in, please.
lines.zh: 嗨。我想辦理入住。

lines.en: Certainly. Do you have a reservation?
lines.zh: 沒問題。請問您有預約嗎？

lines.en: Yes, under the name Ryan Miller.
lines.zh: 有，用 Ryan Miller 的名字。

lines.en: Let me check. Yes, Mr. Miller. A single room for three nights, is that right?
lines.zh: 我查一下。有的，Miller 先生。單人房三晚，對嗎？

lines.en: That's right. I'm here for a business trip.
lines.zh: 沒錯。我是來出差的。

lines.en: Is this your first time in our city?
lines.zh: 這是您第一次來我們這座城市嗎？

lines.en: No, I come here twice a year for work.
lines.zh: 不是，我一年因為工作會來兩次。

lines.en: Wonderful. Your room is on the sixth floor. Here is your key card.
lines.zh: 太好了。您的房間在六樓。這是您的房卡。

lines.en: Thank you. Would it be possible to get a room on a higher floor?
lines.zh: 謝謝。有沒有可能換到比較高的樓層？

lines.en: Of course. May I ask why?
lines.zh: 當然可以。方便問一下原因嗎？

lines.en: I prefer a quiet room, and the street can be noisy.
lines.zh: 我喜歡安靜的房間，而且街上可能很吵。

lines.en: I see. Let me see if a room is available.
lines.zh: 我了解了。讓我看看有沒有空房。

lines.en: Yes, we have one on the ninth floor. It's available tonight.
lines.zh: 有的，九樓有一間。今晚可以入住。

lines.en: That would be perfect. Is breakfast included?
lines.zh: 那太好了。有含早餐嗎？

lines.en: Yes, it is. Breakfast is served from six thirty to ten, on the first floor.
lines.zh: 有的。早餐在一樓供應，從六點半到十點。

lines.en: Great. Also, one question. Would it be possible to check out late on Friday?
lines.zh: 太好了。另外還有一個問題。星期五有沒有可能晚點退房？

lines.en: Let me check. Normally check-out is at eleven. I can give you until two in the afternoon.
lines.zh: 我查一下。一般退房是十一點。我可以讓您延到下午兩點。

lines.en: Two o'clock is fine. Thank you so much.
lines.zh: 兩點就可以了。非常謝謝你。

lines.en: No problem. I'll make a note on your reservation.
lines.zh: 不客氣。我會在您的預約上做個記錄。

lines.en: One more thing. What is the Wi-Fi password? I need to join a video call at eight.
lines.zh: 還有一件事。Wi-Fi 密碼是什麼？我八點要開視訊會議。

lines.en: It's on the card in your key holder.
lines.zh: 寫在您房卡套的那張卡片上。

lines.en: Got it. Is there a place nearby for dinner?
lines.zh: 知道了。附近有地方可以吃晚餐嗎？

lines.en: Yes, there's a good Italian restaurant across the street. It's open until eleven.
lines.zh: 有的，對面有一家不錯的義大利餐廳。營業到十一點。

lines.en: Perfect. I'm starving after the flight.
lines.zh: 太好了。搭完飛機我餓壞了。

lines.en: Please go soon. The popular dishes often run out of stock after eight.
lines.zh: 請早點去。熱門的菜色八點後常常就賣完了。

lines.en: Thanks for the tip. I'll go right now.
lines.zh: 謝謝你的提醒。我現在就去。

lines.en: Just tell them you're a guest here. The staff will take care of you.
lines.zh: 只要告訴他們您是這裡的房客。店員會好好招待您。

lines.en: Nice. What if I need a taxi tomorrow morning?
lines.zh: 太好了。如果我明天早上需要計程車呢？

lines.en: Just call the front desk. We can arrange one for you.
lines.zh: 打電話到櫃檯就好。我們可以幫您安排。

lines.en: Good to know. Would it be possible to get a wake-up call at six thirty?
lines.zh: 知道了。有沒有可能在六點半幫我叫醒？

lines.en: Of course. I'll set it up now.
lines.zh: 當然。我現在就幫您設定。

lines.en: Thank you. You've been very helpful.
lines.zh: 謝謝你。你幫了我很大的忙。

lines.en: My pleasure, Mr. Miller. The elevator is on your left.
lines.zh: 這是我的榮幸，Miller 先生。電梯在您的左手邊。

lines.en: Thanks again. Have a good night.
lines.zh: 再次謝謝。祝你晚安。

lines.en: You too. Enjoy your stay.
lines.zh: 您也是。祝您住得愉快。

quiz.q: Why is Ryan in the city?
quiz.why: I'm here for a business trip.

quiz.q: What time can Ryan check out on Friday?
quiz.why: Hannah 說可以讓他延到下午兩點。

quiz.q: What does Ryan ask for at the end?
quiz.why: 他問能不能在六點半叫醒他。

words.ex1: Hi. I'd like to check in, please.
words.ex2: Please check in at the front desk when you arrive at the factory.
words.ex2zh: 到工廠時請先到櫃檯報到。

words.ex1: Please go soon. The popular dishes often run out of stock after eight.
words.ex2: We might run out of spare parts before the end of the month.
words.ex2zh: 我們可能在月底前就把備用零件用完了。

words.ex1: Just tell them you're a guest here. The staff will take care of you.
words.ex2: Don't worry, our team will take care of the order.
words.ex2zh: 別擔心，我們的團隊會處理這張訂單。

words.ex1: Certainly. Do you have a reservation?
words.ex2: I made a reservation for the meeting room at two o'clock.
words.ex2zh: 我預約了兩點的會議室。

words.ex1: I see. Let me see if a room is available.
words.ex2: Is the quality manager available for a call this afternoon?
words.ex2zh: 品質經理今天下午有空通電話嗎？

speaking.pattern: Would it be possible to + 原形動詞 ...?
speaking.patternZh: 有沒有可能……？（客氣地提出請求）

part2.q: What time does the training start?
part2.why: 問 What time 要回答時間點。A 是地點，C 是時間長度，都不是答案。

part2.q: Could you book a meeting room for tomorrow?
opts: Sure, what time do you need it?
part2.why: Could you 是請求。A 重複 book 的類似字、B 重複 room 都是陷阱。
part2.zh: 你可以幫忙訂明天的會議室嗎？

part2.q: How long have you worked here?
part2.why: How long 問時間長度。B 是地點（部門），C 用 Yes 回答 How 問句不對。

part2.q: Why don't we have lunch together?
part2.why: Why don't we 是邀請/建議，Sure 是同意。A 重複 lunch 是陷阱，C 是地點。

part2.q: Are you taking the train or the bus to the airport?
part2.why: 選擇問句不能用 Yes/No 回答。B 重複 airport 是陷阱。
part2.zh: 你要搭火車還是公車去機場？
